description: Turn google.com/goto redirect links from a recent search into real URLs via Serper /resolve (free, 0 credits). Requires exactly one of: search_id, or links. Pass the search_id a search result asked for, or a list of goto links. Right after a search one call takes ~20–30 s. Links not ready yet stay goto links; Serper then suggests a wait (often 90 s), which is only honoured if it fits in max_wait_seconds — otherwise call again later.

links.description: google.com/goto?url=… links to resolve (alternative to search_id, max 100).

max_wait_seconds.description: Retry within this budget when Serper says to wait (default 60).

search_id.description: search_id shown in a search result that still had goto links.

name: resolve_links
